title.zh: 退火，不只是把晶圆加热
title.en: Annealing is more than heating a wafer

subtitle.zh: 炉管、RTA、Spike、Flash和Laser到底有什么不同
subtitle.en: How do furnace, RTA, Spike, Flash and Laser differ?

body.zh: 从激活、修复到相变与钝化
body.en: From activation and repair to phase change and passivation

body.zh: 同一峰温不等于同一热预算
body.en: The same peak temperature does not imply the same thermal budget

body.zh: 批量均温，但热预算更大
body.en: Batch temperature uniformity, but a greater thermal budget

body.zh: 单片快升快降，兼顾反应与扩散
body.en: Rapid single-wafer heating and cooling balance reaction and diffusion

body.zh: 峰值近零驻留，抢激活、控扩散
body.en: Almost zero dwell at the peak: activate dopants while controlling diffusion

body.zh: 毫秒级大面积表面加热
局部超快，但更怕光学差异
body.en: Ultrafast local heating, but greater sensitivity to optical differences
N₂, Ar, O₂ and forming gas play different roles

body.zh: 形成气氧化修复；还原钝化
body.en: Forming gas Oxidative repair; reductive passivation

body.zh: 物理稳定；界面优化；缺陷修复
body.en: Physical stability; interface optimization; defect repair
Close the loop with Rs, SIMS and electrical results

body.zh: 目标受限条件设备能力工艺风险工艺方案量测验证
body.en: Target Constraints Equipment capability Process risks Process proposal Metrology validation
